name: ctc-club
description: Modern Learning Management System built with React, Node.js, and MongoDB
author: CTC Club Team

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev
scripts.audit:fix: npm --prefix backend audit fix && npm --prefix frontend audit fix
scripts.clean: npm --prefix backend run clean && npm --prefix frontend run clean
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.predeploy: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
